# Slate

> Slate is an online whiteboard and diagramming workspace for software teams. Draw architecture diagrams on an infinite canvas, generate them from a text prompt with AI, or write them as code, and keep the documentation in a markdown editor beside the board. Boards are collaborative in real time.

Website: https://slate.tanmaymirgal.dev

## Pages

- [Home](https://slate.tanmaymirgal.dev/): product overview, features, pricing and FAQ
- [Playground](https://slate.tanmaymirgal.dev/playground): a free whiteboard that runs in the browser with no account
- [How-to video](https://slate.tanmaymirgal.dev/slate-how-to.mp4): 25-second walkthrough, from a template to a shared board

## What Slate does

- AI diagram generator: describe a system in plain language and get an editable, auto-laid-out diagram (architecture, flowchart, ER, mind map, sequence).
- Diagram as code: a text syntax that round-trips with the canvas, plus 10 built-in templates.
- Import code: paste a docker-compose.yml, SQL schema or folder tree and get a diagram and matching documentation.
- Real-time collaboration: live cursors, shared selections, "anyone with the link" sharing and workspace roles.
- Markdown documentation beside the canvas, with export to PNG, SVG and JSON.
- Cloud cost (FinOps) estimate for AWS, GCP and Azure services on the board, and a traffic simulator that flags single points of failure.
- System design interview mode with a timer, requirement checklist and architecture review.

## Pricing (INR)

- Free: 3 boards, 15 AI diagram credits per month.
- Pro: 999 per month, unlimited boards, 300 AI credits per month, 4K export.
- Team: 1,999 per seat per month, 1,000 AI credits per month, unlimited workspaces, roles.
